analysis: This 74-year-old male demonstrates excellent functional resilience despite moderate treatment-related toxicities. ECOG performance status improved from 1 to 0 and remained stable, indicating full independence. Weight fluctuations were minor (83→78→80 kg), with no evidence of progressive cachexia. All adverse events (anaemia, leukopenia, neutropenia, fatigue, appetite loss) resolved without impairing daily function. Prognosis is favorable with low short-term mortality risk. Continued monitoring is warranted, but aggressive intervention is not indicated given preserved functional status.
